changelog: New channel: Holiday TV (ch 69) — a permanent 365-day channel for Thanksgiving, Christmas, New Year, Valentine's Day, Easter and Summer, built from public-domain Internet Archive content (15 items: Rudolph 1948, Santa Claus 1959, Sappy New Year 1961, Christmas Comes But Once A Year 1936, and more). Everything else from 0.3.0.5 is unchanged.
description: Turns the Internet Archive into a retro-video library and live channels inside Jellyfin.
name: Retro TV
overview: Retro TV — Saturday-morning cartoons, classic TV, drive-in movies and more, from the Internet Archive.
